column1: # One turn that touches every branch of the ladder, in the order the events
# would arrive. `lane` is what the pane reports after the row's hook has fired.
# The two rows a successful turn never produces are here on purpose. A question
# and a permission request are the only two things that put a Kimi pane in the
# blocked lane, and each has its own resolving event; if either resolver were
# dropped the pane would latch on blocked, which is the failure this file exists
